subject: Initiating security review & prefill questions for HelmCorp engagement
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@helmcorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps: security intake (SIG prefill attached)

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the product+security discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your security team what they need without blocking the procurement flow: 

Summary from our call:
- HelmCorp primary concern: SOC 2 status, GDPR data residency for EU customers, and HIPAA applicability for one pilot customer.
- You prefer a SIG/CAIQ-style prefill to speed review versus answering a custom PDF.
- Procurement will need standard SLAs and any third-party attestations (SOC 2 report, pen test summary).

What we attached and why:
- helmcorp_SIG-prefill.xlsx — our one-page SIG/CAIQ prefill we can complete and send back; we usually prefill answers and mark required evidence items.

Clarifying questions for scope (can you confirm these so our prefill is accurate?):
1) Data residency: is the pilot customer data required to remain in EU-only regions, or is HelmCorp comfortable with US processing for the initial PoC?
2) HIPAA: is HelmCorp required to sign a Business Associate Agreement for the pilot, or is the pilot scoped to non-PHI datasets?
3) Compliance depth: do you want a full SIG Lite vs. CAIQ vs. custom questionnaire? You mentioned preferring a SIG-style intake — we can do SIG Lite or full SIG.
4) Timeline: what internal deadline does security/procurement have for initial assessment (target date)?

Next steps proposed by Redwood:
- I’ll prefill the SIG-lite columns and mark the short/evidence items for your team to review (Ben will lead).
- If you confirm HIPAA applies, we’ll attach our SOC 2 Type II timeline + BAA standard language (we can provide a redline).
- Schedule a short scoping call (15–20 min) with HelmCorp security if you want to walk through the prefill.

If you can reply with answers to the four scope questions above and confirm the best contact for procurement (I have procurement@helmcorp.com but please add the contract reviewer if different), we’ll return a completed prefill within 48 hours.

Thanks —
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
mobile: +1 (415) 555-0126
[Attachment: helmcorp_SIG-prefill.xlsx]
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@helmcorp.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@helmcorp.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 20:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps: security intake (SIG prefill attached)

Hi Aisha —

Appreciate the recap and the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side: 

Answers to your scope questions:
1) Data residency: For the pilot, we need EU-only processing for any data tied to EU customers. We can discuss scope reduction if needed, but please flag any controls that rely on US services.
2) HIPAA: The pilot MAY include PHI depending on the integration; Procurement wants to know whether Redwood will sign a BAA.
3) Questionnaire format: SIG Lite is preferred for speed; if Redwood can do a CAIQ-lite mapping to SIG answers, that works too.
4) Timeline: Target initial security review complete by 2026-08-12 to stay on track with procurement.

Procurement contact: procurement@helmcorp.com (copied). Contract reviewer is Rajesh Patel (rajesh.patel@helmcorp.com) — please include him on legal/BAA threads.

Additional asks from HelmCorp security:
- Will you provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report or an attestation/bridge letter if the latest audit is in-progress?
- Do you have a recent pen-test summary (redacted OK)?
- Can you provide an evidence index (mapping questions to artifacts) to speed our review?

We’d prefer to get the SIG prefill first and then schedule a 15–20 minute call the week of 2026-08-02.

Thanks,
Samira
Security Program Manager, HelmCorp
[Attachment: helmcorp_procurement-terms.pdf]
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@helmcorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps: security intake (SIG prefill attached)

Samira —

Thanks, that’s very helpful. Quick answers and what we’ll do next: 

SOC 2 / pen test: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II audit in 2025; the full report is available under NDA. For deals in progress where the next audit is underway, we can provide a SOC 2 bridge letter and the prior full report on request. We also have a summary pen-test report (redacted) we can share.

BAA: Redwood will negotiate standard BAA language; we have a template we can share. If PHI is confirmed, please confirm and we’ll loop legal early.

Data residency: we support EU-only processing for tenant-configured workloads in our Dedicated and Private options. For hosted API, we can route and restrict processing to EU regions for customer data; we’ll document the controls in the evidence index.

SIG prefill / evidence index: Ben will take the helm on the SIG-lite prefill and produce a short evidence index PDF (redwood_evidence-index.pdf) mapping high-priority questions to artifacts. We’ll mark anything that requires an NDA or redaction. Expect the completed SIG-lite prefill + evidence index by end of day Monday 2026-07-27 (48 hours).

Proposed next steps I’ll execute now:
- Ben to complete the helmcorp_SIG-prefill.xlsx with SIG-lite answers and flag required artifacts.
- Send SOC 2 bridge letter + redacted pen-test summary under NDA.
- Schedule 15-minute scoping call the week of 2026-08-02 — can you propose two 30-minute windows and we’ll confirm?

Ben, Vivek — taking ownership to assemble the evidence index and the prefill. I’ll track BAA redline with legal if Samira confirms PHI.

Best,
Aisha
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_evidence-index.pdf]
